Commercial Clients

Built for the People Responsible for the Building

Catalyst's commercial customers include property managers, facility and maintenance directors, owners of small and mid-size commercial buildings, and senior living operators. Each one needs a clear technical answer, a realistic schedule and someone accountable for follow-through.

  • Property and facility managers: responsive service, clear findings and documentation they can pass up the chain.
  • Owners: practical repair-versus-replace decisions and cost visibility.
  • Retail, entertainment and church facility teams: work scheduled around shoppers, showtimes and services.

Commercial Buildings We Serve

HVAC for the Buildings Houston Works, Shops and Gathers In

Every commercial building uses its HVAC differently. Catalyst plans service, maintenance and replacements around how the building is used.

Shopping Centers and Retail

Multiple tenants, rooftop units over every suite and questions about who owns which equipment. Catalyst works with landlords and property managers to keep tenants comfortable and responsibilities clear.

Movie Theaters

Large auditoriums that fill up fast and need to cool down before every showing. Work is scheduled around showtimes, and maintenance keeps systems ready for the busiest weekends.

Big-Box Stores

Large open floors served by many rooftop units, where one failed unit shows up as a hot aisle. Planned maintenance and fast repairs keep the sales floor comfortable.

Churches and Houses of Worship

Buildings that go from nearly empty to full in an hour. Catalyst schedules work around services and events and helps plan equipment that handles big crowds without running all week.

Offices and Professional Buildings

Steady comfort for tenants and staff, with work scheduled around business hours.

Modular Homes and Buildings

Compact packaged and wall-mounted systems sized for modular construction.

Commercial HVAC Questions

What types of commercial properties does Catalyst work on?
Shopping centers and retail, movie theaters, big-box stores, churches, office buildings and modular homes and buildings. Apartment and senior living communities have their own Multi-Family HVAC page, and industrial facilities are covered on the Industrial HVAC page.
Does Catalyst offer commercial maintenance agreements?
Yes. Agreements are built around your equipment list, with scheduled visits and a written report after each one.
Can work be scheduled around building operations?
It depends on the equipment and the work. Access windows and operating constraints are agreed before the schedule is set.
Can Catalyst work around church services or theater showtimes?
Yes. Work is scheduled around services, events and showtimes, and access windows are agreed before the job starts.
Does Catalyst service shopping centers with multiple tenants?
Yes. Catalyst works with landlords and property managers on tenant systems and common areas, with clear documentation of what was done in each suite.
Does Catalyst offer after-hours commercial service?
